text:
Which statement about total internal reflection at a glass–air boundary is correct?
A
The angle of incidence inside the glass must be equal to the critical angle.
B
The angle of incidence inside the glass must be less than the critical angle.
C
The critical angle is proportional to the refractive index of the glass.
D
The speed of light in glass must be less than the speed of light in air.

options.label: A
options.text: The angle of incidence inside the glass must be equal to the critical angle.

options.label: B
options.text: The angle of incidence inside the glass must be less than the critical angle.

options.label: C
options.text: The critical angle is proportional to the refractive index of the glass.

options.label: D
